title: Triage Spotify expiry finding C-1 and retry classification C-2
acceptance: Reconfirm expired-grant and retry/reconnect classification on current main.
Agree packet 3 and an actual browser/audio acceptance procedure before implementing provider changes.
nextAction: Owner: review the proposed packet 3 in RF-216 (scope, error mapping and the three-step browser check). If you agree, set RF-216 Ready; RF-92 then closes as Done. RF-158 and RF-167 wait on RF-216.

evidence.summary: Audit packet 3 remains actionable. It was tabled with Spotify until the owner reopened Spotify on 2026-10-28.

Owner decision in session on 2026-10-28: Spotify work is reopened (the family now has Spotify Family). The Apple Music subscription ends around 2026-11-27, so Apple hardening and Apple device checks come first in that window.

Read-only check on production a1b971d in the owner signed-in browser, 2026-10-31 (Neo): Music shows Spotify Connected and Music > Songs lists Spotify liked songs (Re-Arranged, High Speed, Paradise Circus and more) with no allowlist or 403 message. The Air conductor saw the same in the owner recording. So the developer app no longer rejects this account for likes; playlists, playback and other accounts were not checked.

C-1 still holds on main f9aba1b7: providerConnectionState returns 'expired' when expiresAt <= now for any account-backed provider, and the coordinator's liveConnections keeps only 'connected', so a Spotify-only track becomes no_connected_provider about an hour after the last server-side refresh. Wider than the audit said: the same 'expired' state drives 'Session expired' and Reconnect in Dashboard, TrackSearch, ConnectionsDialog and ConnectionStateMark.
GET /providers/connections returns the stored expiresAt and never refreshes; the view does not say whether a refresh token exists.

C-2 still holds: a bare catch around refreshSpotifyToken maps every failure (Spotify 5xx, 429, network, invalid_grant) to 409 REAUTH_REQUIRED. user-likes.ts and user-playlists.ts have the same bare catch. packages/music/src/spotify-oauth.ts postToken throws a plain ProviderError with only the status in its message and never reads the OAuth error code, so the API cannot tell invalid_grant from an outage today.
Owner set RF-92 Ready and approved the start in the Air session, 2026-11-12 (D27: Spotify first).
This triage PR: records only, no provider code. Packet 3 proposed as RF-216.
